children: CME Group reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.74 billion, up 13% from a year earlier, while net income rose 14% to $1.04 billion and diluted EPS increased 16% to $2.89. Higher trading activity and market data revenue contributed to growth.
Revenue was $1.74B, compared with $1.54B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 13%.
Net income was $1.04B, compared with $908M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 14%.
Diluted EPS was $2.89, compared with $2.49 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 16%.
Average daily volume increased 16%, with growth across interest rates, equities, foreign exchange, energy, agriculture and metals.
Clearing and transaction fees rose 12%, while market data revenue grew 20%, reflecting increased product usage, new customer segments and price increases.
Average revenue per futures and options contract fell 3%, reflecting a greater mix of lower-priced micro contracts and member trading.
Technology support costs increased as third-party services supported the ongoing Google Cloud transformation.
